asked.item: Add company name and address to invoices
Set up yourself or email someone each month

verdict.reason: The help pages say you update company name and address yourself in the billing portal, and future invoices include the updated details.

steps.text: You can set this up yourself: go to Settings > Billing and click "View Billing Portal".
Open your billing information and update your company name and address.
Future invoices will include your updated company information.
